headword: データ{入力|にゅうりょく}

definitions.explanation: The process of entering data into a computer system, database, or spreadsheet. Also refers to the job or task of typing information into digital systems, a common type of office and part-time work.

examples.japanese: データ{入力|にゅうりょく}の{仕事|しごと}を{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I'm looking for a data entry job.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{大量|たいりょう}のデータ{入力|にゅうりょく}をしなければならない。
examples.english: I have to do a large amount of data entry every day.

examples.japanese: データ{入力|にゅうりょく}のミスを{防|ふせ}ぐために、ダブルチェックの{体制|たいせい}を{整|ととの}えた。
examples.english: To prevent data entry errors, we established a double-checking system.

notes:
Composed of データ (data, from English) and {入力|にゅうりょく} (input; entry). A standard term in office and IT environments. Data entry work (データ{入力|にゅうりょく}の{仕事|しごと}) is a common part-time and remote job category in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- データ{入力|にゅうりょく}の{仕事|しごと}: data entry work/job
- データ{入力|にゅうりょく}ミス: data entry error
- データ{入力|にゅうりょく}{作業|さぎょう}: data entry task/operation
- データ{入力|にゅうりょく}{画面|がめん}: data entry screen

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {入力|にゅうりょく}: input — the general act of entering information into a system
- {打|う}ち{込|こ}み: typing in; keying in — emphasizes the physical act of typing
- データ{処理|しょり}: data processing — broader term covering manipulation and analysis of data, not just entry
